title: Support for Proxy-Authorization in http security scheme

raw.title: Support for Proxy-Authorization in http security scheme
raw.body: Hi - the OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification implies [here](https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/blob/master/versions/3.0.3.md#securitySchemeObject) that for the `http` security scheme only Authorization header from RFC7235 may be used to supply credentials, such as a bearer token.  Would it be at all possible to include support for Proxy-Authorization (without the need to use a specification extension)?  The use case is to supply separate proxy and target credentials in one API request.
